scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of universal large-h asymptotics; finite supplementary checks do not prove the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional C2 hyperbolic endpoints, forward-complete flow, positive restoring drift on (0,1), sufficient upper confinement. Coarse h only; no claims for nonhyperbolic endpoints, higher-dimensional systems or stochastic exit probabilities. General large-h law is not independently audited. The motivating paper already proves the exact scalar maximum formula and explicit cubic example.
title: A sharp coarse-sampling resilience law for scalar saddle-to-sink flows
